Chapter 6401: Love Grotto

Chapter 6401: Love Grotto

The group left Heavenpray Peak and Goldblade took them to another island.

One would think they were in the wrong place because this place had no semblance of being a villain’s lair. It had flowers and birds chirping, looking like a paradise. Spring embraced visitors like a mother’s warm touch.

Everything was arranged exquisitely. The flowers, plants, and buildings exuded poetic charm; all adding to an idyllic image.

The men were strikingly handsome while the women were gorgeous. They lived together in harmony, awaiting dawn and dusk.

The most magical part was that none of them aged. All were young and full of life.

As one delved deeper into the island, they would never want to leave this place full of beauties and wine.

The scene and atmosphere changed the farther they went in. The people wore fewer and fewer clothes, revealing their perfect curves.

The women became more beautiful. Their smiles could tempt anyone. They started circling and serving the group - a scene only found in heaven.

Each woman had a different charm - sexy, bashful, mature like a ripe peach... just one bite and juice would flow out...

People could easily forget everything else and prefer to stay here forever. Alch-deer immediately protected his mind.

A woman jumped into his embrace, whispering sweet messages. He sat upright and ignored her advances.

On the other hand, Li Qiye and Goldblade didn’t bother stopping them.

“Oh, isn’t this little Alch-deer? A lot more handsome after just a few years.” A supreme beauty approached slowly.

Her frowns and smiles captivated the soul with an irresistible allure. She was dressed in a delicate fabric, revealing glimpses of her wonderful figure. Her snow-white skin invited others to come and take a bite.

Her breath was as fragrant as orchids, making one’s heart race faster.

Alch-deer protected his dao heart as he spoke: “Yin-yang Lady.”

“It is an honor to be remembered by you, Handsome.” She smiled.

He was on high alert because her charming techniques were frightening. Just one mishap and it would be over.

“Don’t be so nervous now, we almost had a thing going if it wasn’t for Dragon-pill Emperor.” She added.

Goldblade watched with great amusement, wondering how long Alch-deer could last.

Alch-deer took a deep breath after the past was brought up and said: “Yin-yang Lady, your charm art is useless to me now, tell Yin-yang Master to appear.”

“I’ll listen since I like pretty men from Desolate Frontier the most.” She winked.

“You shouldn’t mess with Desolate Frontier.” Someone spoke lazily.

She looked over and saw Li Qiye resting on a beauty’s thigh while allowing her to feed him. He looked calm and content as if this was the natural order.

It appeared that he was the master in this place; everything belonged to him whether it be the area or those living in it. Enjoying these pleasures was expected and ordinary.

At first, she thought he had lost his way to the temptation. However, something was amiss since nothing was affecting him.

“Who are you?” She frowned.

“Lady, this child’s play needs to stop in the presence of the young noble. He is a supreme ancestor of Desolate Frontier.” Goldblade shook his head.

“Supreme ancestor?!” Yin-yang Lady became startled and the indiscernible charm melodies dissipated.

The women nearby froze instantly upon hearing this.

“Which ancestor?” A handsome youth appeared, capable of winning any woman’s heart.

“Here you are, Yin-yang Master.” Alch-deer said.

The lady returned to her husband’s side, posing in a ready stance against Li Qiye.

“Why are members of Desolate Frontier visiting my place?” Yin-yang Master stared cautiously at Li Qiye.

Meanwhile, the beauties around Li Qiye stopped since he didn’t fall to their charm.

“Continue.” Li Qiye waved his hand and ordered.

They had no choice but to continue, albeit this time without any charming technique.

The Yin-yang couple stood there in a daze, not knowing what to do.

“They are part of the nine villains.” Goldblade introduced.

They weren’t evil compared to the worst members. When they were younger, they gathered the yin and yang forces from virgins. Disciples from Desolate Frontier noticed this and pursued them.

Although they were strong, they had no choice but to join Isles of Evil. Both had ten sacred fruits and had the seventh position.

They naturally hated Desolate Frontier for pushing them to this point. However, they knew and respected Desolate Frontier’s strength.

If it truly had wanted to kill them, sending one emperor back then was enough. However, the top masters didn’t wish to hunt them.

“Goldblade Emperor, we never offended you so why are you bringing them to our grotto?” Yin-yang Master asked.
